mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing hydrocodone metabolism and increasing opioid levels; additionally, both drugs have CNS depressant effects and disulfiram may impair alcohol metabolism in patients with concurrent use.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, reduce hydrocodone dose significantly, monitor for respiratory depression and excessive sedation, and counsel patient on alcohol avoidance.
